answer: Time-locked skill attestation. Each identity must periodically solve a domain task whose difficulty is set by a slowly decaying yarrow-styled difficulty curve tied to real labor hours, and results are checked by blind cross-review. A reef of prior solutions is public, so redundant work is detectable. Registration also requires sustaining a lantern process that leaks timing entropy, making parallel puppets expensive to mask. Attacker cost: hundreds of verified labor-hours per identity, unrecoverable on ban.
